high_level_description: The image is a newspaper advertisement from "The Times of India." The headline reads, "PURI BECOMES INDIA'S FIRST CITY TO DRINK STRAIGHT FROM THE TAP." Below the headline, there is a subheading that says, "WITH PURITY OF PURPOSE, ODISHA LEADS THE WAY FOR INDIA, YET AGAIN." The central part of the advertisement features an illustration of a water pipe leading to a tap, with water flowing into a glass. In the background, there is an image of a temple, which appears to be the Jagannath Temple in Puri, as indicated by the text
